create.name: Byron Yoga Centre
create.bio:
Byron Yoga Centre is a residential yoga school on a thirty-acre property just outside the town of Byron Bay in northern New South Wales. John Ogilvie, who still leads it as founder and chief executive, began teaching in the town in 1986 and opened the centre with two fellow teachers in 1988. After two decades of training in the Iyengar and Ashtanga traditions he shaped his own approach, Purna Yoga, a name meaning complete: alignment-based posture work with props, joined to breathing practice, meditation, philosophy and the ethical code of yoga. Since 2010 the school has run its programmes on its own land at Skinners Shoot, with a garden kitchen serving sattvic vegetarian food and on-site cabins and rooms.

Teacher education is the school's main work. A 200-hour Level 1 course runs in 20-, 12- or 7-day residential formats several times a year, a 300-hour Level 2 builds on it, and shorter modules, such as a meditation immersion, can count towards those hours. The centre is also a registered training organisation offering a Certificate IV in yoga teaching. Alongside the trainings it hosts weekly five- and seven-day yoga retreats, day retreats and an annual trip to India, with Marita Dortins as head teacher trainer.

courses.title: Level 1 200hr Yoga Teacher Training
courses.description: The school's foundation training in Purna Yoga, accredited at 200 hours, taken on site as a 20-day residential or as shorter 12- and 7-day versions with study before and afterwards. Intakes are listed for January, April, late June and August 2027.

courses.title: Level 2 300hr Yoga Teacher Training
courses.description: A fortnight's residential course for teachers who already hold a 200-hour qualification, framed by online study before and after. Together with chosen specialist modules it completes 300 hours.

courses.title: 6 Day Meditation Immersion
courses.description: A new 50-hour residential course led by Bec Isaacs, combining guided sitting practice, yogic breathing, asana and talks on the philosophy of meditation. It can count towards the school's 300-hour programme.

courses.title: 5 Day Yoga Retreat
courses.description: A weekly residential retreat at the centre with several yoga classes a day, meditation, vegetarian meals and short sessions on asana alignment, cooking and the gardens. Each season has its own theme, and guests join in as much as they wish.
